# derived from monero v0.18.5.1 source, not captured from a run
# fields: COMMAND_RPC_GET_VERSION::response_t, src/rpc/core_rpc_server_commands_defs.h:2196-2212
#         { version u32, release bool, current_height u64, target_height u64,
#           hard_forks[] = hf_entry (:2183-2194, { hf_version u8, height u64 }) }
# base:   rpc_response_base only (status, untrusted) :101-112
# `version` IS THE RPC VERSION, NOT THE SOFTWARE VERSION. It is CORE_RPC_VERSION =
#         (CORE_RPC_VERSION_MAJOR << 16) | CORE_RPC_VERSION_MINOR with MAJOR 3 and MINOR 16
#         (:91-94) = (3 << 16) | 16 = 196624. The software version string is get_info.version
#         ("0.18.5.1-release"). DESIGN.md §5c keeps them apart under `node info`.rpc.
# current_height / target_height / hard_forks are KV_SERIALIZE_OPT (:2208-2210), so monerod omits
#         them when they are empty/zero; they are present here because a synced node fills them.
#         current_height matches get_info.json's height (3541122) and target_height is 0 when synced,
#         the same convention get_info uses (src/rpc/core_rpc_server.cpp:523).
# hard_forks[] is the mainnet fork table VERBATIM from src/hardforks/hardforks.cpp:34-76 -- the
#         (version, height) pair of each row, in order. The table ENDS AT v16 @ 2689608 (:75): FCMP++
#         / Carrot is not activated, so `hard_fork_info` reports version 16 until a v17 row ships.
#         Each row's fourth C++ field (e.g. 1656629118 for v16) is hardfork_t::time
#         (src/hardforks/hardforks.h:34-41) and is NOT serialized here and NOT the date that height
#         was mined -- DESIGN.md §1b.1 forbids rendering it as a block date.
# gate:   OPEN -- MAP_JON_RPC("get_version", ...) has no !m_restricted guard
#         (src/rpc/core_rpc_server.h:174).
# BOTH ROLES have a get_version fixture (this one and wallet/get_version.json) and they answer
#         different shapes; that is exactly why fmonero-mock takes --role.
